# serverless.yml
#
# Deploys the cloud half of the human-in-the-loop browser agent:
#   - DynamoDB table for approval requests
#   - S3 bucket for CSV uploads
#   - SQS queue that receives S3 ObjectCreated notifications
#   - Lambda function (processUpload) triggered by SQS
#
# Flow:
#   Streamlit upload -> S3 (uploads/*.csv) -> SQS -> Lambda
#     -> reads CSV from S3 -> writes one DynamoDB approval request per valid row
#
# About the S3 -> SQS notification "circular dependency":
#   The S3 bucket's NotificationConfiguration references the SQS queue, and the
#   SQS queue policy needs to reference the bucket's ARN to allow it to send
#   messages. CloudFormation refuses to deploy if both reference each other via
#   logical IDs (a true cycle).
#
#   The clean fix is to NOT reference the bucket as a CloudFormation resource
#   inside the queue policy - instead we build the bucket ARN as a STRING from
#   the same deterministic name we use to create the bucket. The bucket then
#   uses DependsOn to make sure the queue policy is created before it is, so by
#   the time S3 publishes its first event the queue already accepts it.

service: human-in-loop-browser-agent-backend

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: python3.12
  region: ${opt:region, "us-east-1"}
  stage: ${opt:stage, "dev"}

  # These env vars are exposed to the Lambda at runtime.
  environment:
    APPROVAL_TABLE_NAME: ${self:service}-${self:provider.stage}-approval-requests
    UPLOAD_BUCKET_NAME: ${self:service}-${self:provider.stage}-${aws:accountId}-uploads

  iam:
    role:
      statements:
        # Read uploaded CSVs from the S3 bucket.
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - s3:GetObject
          Resource: "arn:aws:s3:::${self:provider.environment.UPLOAD_BUCKET_NAME}/*"

        # Write approval request items to DynamoDB.
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - dynamodb:PutItem
          Resource: !GetAtt ApprovalRequestsTable.Arn

        # Consume messages from the SQS upload queue.
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - sqs:ReceiveMessage
            - sqs:DeleteMessage
            - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
          Resource: !GetAtt UploadQueue.Arn
        # CloudWatch Logs permissions are added automatically by Serverless.

# Keep the Lambda package small. Only ship the handler + src/.
package:
  patterns:
    - "!**/__pycache__/**"
    - "!**/.pytest_cache/**"
    - "!.venv/**"
    - "!venv/**"
    - "!node_modules/**"
    - "!README.md"
    - "lambda_handler.py"
    - "src/**"

functions:
  processUpload:
    handler: lambda_handler.process_upload
    timeout: 60
    memorySize: 256
    events:
      - sqs:
          arn: !GetAtt UploadQueue.Arn
          # batchSize: 1 keeps each S3 event in its own Lambda invocation,
          # which makes debugging much easier for beginners.
          batchSize: 1

resources:
  Resources:
    # --- DynamoDB: approval requests table -----------------------------------
    ApprovalRequestsTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: ${self:provider.environment.APPROVAL_TABLE_NAME}
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: request_id
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: request_id
            KeyType: HASH

    # --- SQS: upload queue ---------------------------------------------------
    UploadQueue:
      Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
      Properties:
        QueueName: ${self:service}-${self:provider.stage}-uploads
        # VisibilityTimeout must be >= Lambda timeout (60s here).
        VisibilityTimeout: 90

    # --- SQS queue policy: allow our S3 bucket to send messages --------------
    #
    # We reference the bucket by its known *name* (not by !Ref UploadBucket).
    # This breaks the circular dependency that would otherwise exist between
    # the bucket and the queue policy.
    UploadQueuePolicy:
      Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
      Properties:
        Queues:
          - !Ref UploadQueue
        PolicyDocument:
          Version: "2012-10-17"
          Statement:
            - Sid: AllowS3SendMessage
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                Service: s3.amazonaws.com
              Action: sqs:SendMessage
              Resource: !GetAtt UploadQueue.Arn
              Condition:
                ArnLike:
                  aws:SourceArn: "arn:aws:s3:::${self:provider.environment.UPLOAD_BUCKET_NAME}"

    # --- S3: upload bucket with notification to SQS --------------------------
    #
    # DependsOn: UploadQueuePolicy ensures the queue accepts events from S3
    # before the bucket exists (and therefore before S3 tries to publish).
    UploadBucket:
      Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
      DependsOn: UploadQueuePolicy
      Properties:
        BucketName: ${self:provider.environment.UPLOAD_BUCKET_NAME}
        NotificationConfiguration:
          QueueConfigurations:
            - Event: s3:ObjectCreated:*
              Queue: !GetAtt UploadQueue.Arn
              Filter:
                S3Key:
                  Rules:
                    - Name: prefix
                      Value: uploads/
                    - Name: suffix
                      Value: .csv

  Outputs:
    ApprovalRequestsTableName:
      Description: "DynamoDB table for approval requests (copy into root .env)"
      Value: ${self:provider.environment.APPROVAL_TABLE_NAME}
    UploadBucketName:
      Description: "S3 bucket for CSV uploads (copy into root .env)"
      Value: ${self:provider.environment.UPLOAD_BUCKET_NAME}
    UploadQueueUrl:
      Description: "SQS queue URL"
      Value: !Ref UploadQueue
